item.title: Pro-abortion professor backs out of Notre Dame leadership role amid protests

item.title: Women now surpass men in law, medical school enrollment
item.description: Recent research shows women now surpass men in professional degree programs, including medical and law schools. While some express concern over the lack of gender balance in higher education, others see this trend as neutral. Women also earn more doctorates and master's degrees, while men's college enrollment declines, highlighting a significant shift in educational demographics.
